skill_name: Write a paragraph to explain why vaccinations have increased life expectancy.
workflow: Vaccinations have had a significant effect on life expectancy over the past century. Vaccines have greatly decreased the mortality and morbidity of many dangerous illnesses, including, but not limited to smallpox, polio, measles and whooping cough. With the development of vaccines, millions of Americans are now able to live longer, healthier lives and are protected from these life-threatening diseases.
